ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The following figure is a schematic diagram of a historical famous city on a certain plain in the world. <image1> According to the information reflected in the figure, from the perspective of tourism resource types, what high-quality condition does the development of tourism resources in this place possess?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The legend on the right side of the figure shows that this place has urban human landscapes such as old urban areas and new urban areas, and also marks historical and cultural resources such as ancient large-scale ruins or tombs and religious building ruins; at the same time, the figure also shows natural or ecological landscapes such as rivers and lakes and forest parks. Then reason: The question requires summarizing the condition from the perspective of "tourism resource types". The figure contains both human historical tourism resources and natural ecological tourism resources, indicating that the tourism resources that can be developed are not just one type and that the types are relatively abundant. Therefore, the high-quality condition for tourism resource development in this place is diverse types of tourism resources.

method.method_draft: 先读图例和地图内容：图中不仅有历史城区/旧城区一类的人文景观，还标出了古代大型遗址或陵墓等历史文化资源，同时还有河湖、森林公园等自然或生态景观。再读题干要求“从旅游资源类型看”概括优质条件。把这些不同类别的景观归纳为旅游资源类型不止一种，因此答案为“旅游资源类型多样”。
